A single-cell layout wrapper preserves its nested data table as structured Markdown

```ruby title="Ruby"
require "html_to_markdown"
result = HtmlToMarkdown.convert('<table><tr><td><p>Before</p><table><tr><th>ID</th><th>Status</th></tr><tr><td>123</td><td>Done</td></tr></table></td></tr></table>', HtmlToMarkdown::ConversionOptions.new(br_in_tables: true, compact_tables: true))
puts result.content.inspect
```
